title: Death bomb drop — one auto-spawned bomb in a random adjacent cell to where the ragdoll landed (supersedes Revenge Cart)
intent: Per user feedback 2026-06-02: revenge-cart (GDP-2026-05-30-002, archived as obsolete) is too complex — click input + UI + protocol. Simpler is better. NEW mechanic: when a bomber dies (BomberStats.alive false-flip + ragdoll completes), automatically spawn ONE bomb in a random cardinal-adjacent cell to where the ragdoll body landed. If no adjacent cell available (all hard blocks or other bombs), drop on death cell itself. If still impossible, silent skip. Same rule for both bots and human players. Bomb has default fuse + range. ownerId = dead bomber (kill credit on hit). NO input, NO UI, NO protocol message — just one automatic bomb appearing as a parting shot. Closes the same 1v1 engagement gap (death is meaningful, survivor has to react) without the implementation cost.
rationale: Source: user feedback 2026-06-02. Replaces deferred-as-too-complex GDP-2026-05-30-002 (click-to-throw revenge cart). The simpler version: one auto bomb. Same goal — pressure survivors, death has consequence, 1v1 dynamics richer. Cost dramatically lower: ~80 LOC vs ~250 LOC. No protocol changes. Reuses existing bomb-spawn path entirely. Easier to balance + tune. Marked `should` because it closes the same 1v1 boring-orbit problem with much less risk.
acceptanceHints: NEW FILE: examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/death-bomb-drop-system.ts.
TRIGGER: bomber's BomberStats.alive flips true → false (existing death event). System runs IN PARALLEL to existing ragdoll-spawn + power-up-drop (GDP-2026-05-30-001 if shipped).
TIMING: drop fires immediately on alive-flip frame. The dead bomber's grid cell at the moment of death = the 'death cell'. Bomb spawns 1 frame later to give the existing ragdoll a tick to settle.
RANDOM ADJACENT CELL SELECTION:
Per fixedUpdate after alive-flip: identify candidate cells = 4 cardinals of death cell (N, E, S, W).
Filter to AVAILABLE cells: not hard block, not soft block, not currently containing a bomb, in arena bounds.
If 1+ candidates available: pick ONE via seeded RNG (seed = bomber entity id + scene seed + round number). Deterministic per (dying bomber, round, seed).
If 0 cardinal candidates: try death cell itself — only if death cell is now free (no bomb already there). Drop on death cell.
If still no spawn possible: SILENT SKIP. No bomb. (Edge case — happens when bomber dies surrounded by hard blocks + bombs.)
BOMB SPAWN:
Use existing bomb-placement-system spawn path with: ownerId = dead bomber's entity id, fuseRemaining = 2.5s (default), range = 2 (default — not the dead bomber's range; intentional simpler baseline).
Note: bomb spawns even though placer is dead. The existing bomb-fuse + blast-propagation systems handle this — bomb is owned by an alive=false bomber, but the bomb itself ticks normally.
KILL CREDIT:
If the death-drop bomb's blast kills another bomber: existing kill-credit path applies (bomb ownerId = dead bomber). Dead bomber's tally bumps by 1. Multi-bot tally tracking handles this already.

This means a Coward bot killed by Hunter could spawn a bomb that subsequently kills Hunter → both dead, round resolves as draw OR last-living-decided OR last-kill-credited-decided per existing round-resolve rules.
VISUAL TELEGRAPH:

Brief visual cue on the bomb spawn cell: 0.2s 'pop' particle effect (reuse existing bomb-place-puff particle preset). Player can spot the death-bomb at-a-glance — knows it came from the death event, not a normal placement.
Audio: existing 'bomb-place' clip fires (same as a normal bomb place).
Optional polish: a subtle red tint on the death-drop bomb's mesh (vs normal bomber-coloured bombs) so survivors can read 'this is a death bomb' visually. Not in v1 — equal-look bomb is fine.
ADJACENT TO RAGDOLL LANDING (refinement):

Per user request: 'случайной клетке рядом с тем местом куда улетел рагдолл'. The ragdoll launches via Rapier physics from GDP-2026-05-24-002 (engine ragdoll module — shipped S128). It lands somewhere within ~0.7 cells of the death cell (per S105 + S108 ragdoll arena physics).

Implementation: read the ragdoll body's final landing position at +0.6s (ragdoll despawn moment) and use THAT cell as the basis for adjacent-cell candidates. Ragdoll Y is irrelevant — only XZ → grid cell.
If ragdoll hasn't landed yet at the moment of system tick: fall back to using the death cell (where the bomber's alive-flip happened). Simpler + always works.

RECOMMENDATION for v1: use the DEATH CELL as basis (simpler, deterministic, doesn't depend on ragdoll physics outcome). User's instinct of 'next to ragdoll' is the goal but death cell is close enough visually.
Alternative path (post-v1): read ragdoll despawn cell + use as basis. Stretch polish — adds dependency on ragdoll timing.
URL CONFIG:
`?deathBomb=off` disables — useful for testing classical bomberman behaviour.
`?deathBombRange=N` overrides 2 (1..4 clamped).
INTERACTIONS WITH OTHER SYSTEMS:
Power-up drop on death (GDP-2026-05-30-001): both systems trigger on alive-flip. Order: power-ups drop on death cell, death bomb spawns on adjacent cell. No conflict.
Bot-only acceleration (GDP-2026-05-29-011): if HUMANS_DEAD, bots gain aggression — they ALSO drop death bombs. Multiple bot deaths in chain reactions = multiple parting bombs. Resolves rounds fast.
Sudden Death (S160): if HUMANS_DEAD AND sudden-death-walls shrinking AND multiple bot deaths = chain reactions cascade. Acceptable — leads to dramatic finish.
Ragdoll (S128+): death bomb spawns alongside ragdoll — ragdoll flies via Rapier, death bomb appears at adjacent cell. Both visually present at the same moment.
Multiplayer (S125 server-authoritative): server runs death-bomb-drop-system. Seeded RNG identical across tabs. No protocol changes — bomb spawn already in snapshot path.

DETERMINISM: cell selection deterministic per (dying bomber, scene seed, round number). Bot-vs-bot regression test continues to resolve in budget — possibly faster, since chain reactions occur more often.
TESTS:
Bomber dies in arena interior → death bomb spawns in one of 4 cardinal cells (deterministic).
Bomber dies surrounded by 4 hard blocks → death bomb falls back to death cell. If death cell also blocked (post chain detonation) → silent skip.
Death-bomb-kill: bomb spawned by Coward kills surviving Hunter → Coward gets the kill credit (tally bump posthumous).
Chain reaction: Coward's death bomb's blast triggers other live bombs → chain.
Multi-death same frame (chain blast killing 3 bombers): each spawns its own death bomb at its own death cell + adjacent picking. Deterministic per bomber.
?deathBomb=off → no bomb spawns on death.
VISUAL QA:
Bomber dies → visible ragdoll launch + popping sound + a bomb appears in one of the 4 adjacent cells. Player visually sees the threat.
Survivor caught by death-bomb blast → 'oh damn' moment, very readable.
Sudden Death + death bomb chains: dramatic finale — multiple bots die in rapid succession from each other's death bombs.

OUT OF SCOPE:
Click-to-throw revenge cart (the superseded approach from GDP-2026-05-30-002).
Multiple death bombs per death (always ONE).
Variable death bomb range based on dead bomber's stats (always default range=2 — simpler).
Visual differentiation of death bomb vs normal bomb (optional polish; not in v1).
Cell selection bias (always uniform random across available cardinals — no 'prefer the cell with the killer in it' logic).
Player-launched death bombs (the user died → bomb spawns automatically; no input).
Death bomb chains creating infinite cascade (existing chain-react rules + sudden-death + auto-restart guard against this naturally).
